downloads.title: Linux launcher
downloads.description: Signed updates, repair and rollback. Debian 12 / glibc 2.36+. Desktop OpenGL for launcher; Vulkan for game; ALSA, udev, X11/Wayland and libxkbcommon-x11. Software-rendered checks; audio and interactive gameplay untested.
downloads.label: Get Linux launcher
